reference: In this appeal from the judgment of the trial court dissolving the marriage of the parties, the plaintiff wife claims an abuse of discretion by a state trial referee acting as the trial court (1) in awarding periodic alimony that was limited in its duration, (2) in awarding only $1200 per month in periodic alimony, (3) in establishing a minimal level of expenses, at $1500 before the defendant would have to contribute to the upkeep of the marital residence, and (4) in its order concerning the joint bank accounts with the children. We find error in part.
